acceptance: The check still fails when a removed name returns as a row of the generated index (mutation checked)
fix: Scope the check to the GENERATED:flag-index region of control-flags.md (or to flagregistry.Lookup returning false), so prose that names a removed flag does not fail it.
summary: On main 1db031993 (2026-10-26) `go test -tags acs -count=1 ./acs/cycle31/` fails: TestC31_008_ControlFlagsMdHasNoRemovedRows reports that docs/architecture/control-flags.md contains EVOLVE_BYPASS_PREFIX_GATE, EVOLVE_BYPASS_ROLE_GATE and EVOLVE_BYPASS_SHIP_GATE. The rows are gone from the registry; the names appear only in the prose at control-flags.md:99, which says they have no production reader. The predicate checks a substring of the whole file, not the generated index. No CI job runs acs/cycle*.
title: Archived predicate acs/cycle31 TestC31_008 is red on main: it forbids flag names that control-flags.md now cites in prose
